title: Two Pawns Too Far
setup: White's first two moves opened the one diagonal that ends on its own king.
hint: Only one line points at the white king, and only one black piece can step onto it this move.
explanation:
## The Idea

The f- and g-pawns are the two moves that strip e1 of cover on the h4–e1 diagonal. {{Qh4#}} arrives with nothing to block on and nothing able to capture it. Keep those two pawns at home while your king still lives behind them.
